report_title: July Summer Holiday Packages: Family Luxury Watch

destinations.label: Lombok, Indonesia (Kuta Mandalika beaches; dry season, 19-30°C in July)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No London nonstop and no Business cabin into Lombok. Fastest 1-stop listed on Google Flights for LHR 20 Jul 2027 (read 2026-09-29): Singapore Airlines + Scoot via SIN, 24h with an 8h connection; 2-stop Qatar Airways + Garuda via DOH and CGK, 22h55
destinations.nonstop_source: No London nonstop exists to LOP: every listed London-Lombok itinerary connects, the fastest being Singapore Airlines + Scoot via SIN. Google Flights LHR 20 Jul 2027 (read 2026-09-29) lists no nonstop. Not nonstop.

destinations.label: Koh Samui, Thailand (Gulf side: the drier coast in July, 25-32°C)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No London nonstop. Fastest protected 1-stop listed on Google Flights for LHR 20 Jul 2027 (read 2026-09-29): EVA Air + Bangkok Airways via BKK, 14h55; BA + Bangkok Airways via SIN, 16h50
destinations.nonstop_source: No London nonstop exists to USM: the fastest listed journey is EVA Air + Bangkok Airways via BKK, 14h55 (Google Flights LHR 20 Jul 2027, read 2026-09-29). Not nonstop.

destinations.label: Koh Phangan, Thailand (Gulf side, by boat from Samui; 25-32°C in July)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No airport on Koh Phangan: fly to Koh Samui (USM; fastest protected 1-stop on Google Flights for LHR 20 Jul 2027, read 2026-09-29, EVA Air + Bangkok Airways via BKK, 14h55), then the resort speedboat, about 40 min
destinations.nonstop_source: No London nonstop and no airport on Koh Phangan at all: fly to Koh Samui (USM, fastest listed 1-stop 14h55 via BKK, Google Flights LHR 20 Jul 2027, read 2026-09-29) and take the resort speedboat. Not nonstop.

destinations.label: Khao Lak, Thailand (Andaman side: SW MONSOON in July, 466 mm of rain; 25-32°C)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No nonstop listed for 20 Jul 2027. Fastest 1-stop on Google Flights for LHR-HKT (read 2026-09-29): THAI via BKK, 14h30; Etihad via AUH, 14h35. Then about 1h40 by road from Phuket airport
destinations.nonstop_source: Khao Lak is served from HKT. Google Flights lists NO nonstop for LHR-HKT on 20 Jul 2027 (read 2026-09-29), and Virgin Atlantic's HKT service is SEASONAL (it starts 18 Oct 2026) with no season end given by any source in this repository or the 2026-10-04 research, so the June/July 2027 season cannot be confirmed from here either. UNKNOWN, and unknown is priced economy (owner rule 2026-10-04: business only for a direct flight).

destinations.label: Zanzibar, Tanzania (Nungwi beach; dry season, 22-29°C in July)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No London nonstop. Fastest 1-stop on Google Flights for LHR 20 Dec 2026 (read 2026-09-29): Ethiopian via ADD, 11h40; EgyptAir via CAI 12h20. For 20 Jul 2027: Ethiopian via ADD 11h55
destinations.nonstop_source: No London nonstop exists to ZNZ: the fastest listed journey for 20 Jul 2027 is Ethiopian via Addis Ababa, 11h55, 1 stop. Not nonstop.

destinations.label: Bali, Indonesia (Nusa Dua / Seminyak beaches, 27-30C and dry in July)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No London nonstop. Fastest standard 1-stop via SIN: LHR-SIN nonstop ~13h + connection + SIN-DPS ~2h45, about 17h15 (estimate from published schedules, not live-checked)
destinations.nonstop_source: No London nonstop exists to DPS: the fastest standard journey is 1 stop via SIN, about 17h15 (estimate from published schedules, not live-checked). Not nonstop.

destinations.label: Da Nang & Hoi An, Vietnam (dry-season beaches + heritage town, 33-35C in July)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No London nonstop. Fastest standard 1-stop via BKK, HAN or SGN: London leg ~11h45-12h45 + connection + ~1h15-1h45, about 15h (estimate from published schedules, not live-checked)
destinations.nonstop_source: No London nonstop exists to DAD: every London-Da Nang itinerary connects, via BKK, HAN or SGN. Not nonstop.

destinations.label: Onna Village, Okinawa, Japan (warmest Japanese beach: 27-32°C in July; typhoon season)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No London nonstop: Google Flights states 'There are no direct flights on this route' (read 2026-10-04). LHR-HND on ANA, JAL or BA, then a 2h40 domestic hop to Naha on ANA / JAL / Skymark / Solaseed; fastest listed itinerary 16h30
destinations.nonstop_source: No London nonstop exists to OKA: Google Flights states 'There are no direct flights on this route' (read 2026-10-04). LHR-HND on ANA, JAL or BA, then a 2h40 domestic hop to Naha. Not nonstop, in either season.

destinations.label: Riviera Maya & Tulum, Mexico (Caribbean; 24-34°C in July, but hurricane and sargassum season)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No London nonstop in July 2027: Virgin Atlantic's CUN service runs 18 Oct 2026 - 11 Apr 2027, verified on Virgin Atlantic's own Mexico page (read 2026-10-04). 1 stop via AUH, DOH or IST, about 17h with the connection
destinations.nonstop_source: No London nonstop to CUN in July 2027: Virgin Atlantic's Cancun service runs 18 Oct 2026 - 11 Apr 2027, verified on Virgin Atlantic's own Mexico page (read 2026-10-04), so it has ended by these dates. Every London-Cancun journey in June/July 2027 connects (about 17h via AUH, DOH or IST). Not nonstop.
